rules.admission: Only after a qualifying confirmation; both providers, every pair and all full-case chunks/consolidations must fit $5 at full reservations, otherwise skip the entire module.
rules.evidence: Use existing Track N complete-record assembly and chunking; never substitute packed excerpts or coded gold.
rules.blinding: Union/deduplicate sample 1 first-ten cases by question, strip arm/rank before judging, deterministically shuffle pairs with the frozen seed.
rules.attempts: One attempt per provider/request, no retry, replacement, adjudicator or new provider.
rules.report: Provider-specific P@10/nDCG@10, coverage/agreement, minimum-grade and disagreement ranges, paired group uncertainty. Diagnostic only; cannot rescue a failed coded result.
